stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Stacey's Smart Team has been laid to rest (5.76 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🏟️ Game to watch: TB @ DAL (Thursday 8:15 PM), 10 league starters in action with 127.58 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (TB @ DAL): 10 league starters, led by Kirbo Crushers vs Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Price and Williams for Andrews and Adams back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Team Name leads the chopping-block odds at 29%, with Mel's Mediocre Mob next at 19%.
🔭 Player to watch: Dak Prescott (TB @ DAL). ESPN projects 18.02 pts, and 49er Faith-Fool is 57% against Mr. Action Jackson.
🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Ruffing the Passer right on the line (49%).
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads TDsMaGee 5–3 all-time, and The Mahomies has won the last 2.
🎲 Ramosverse is rolling with 3 TEs (McBride, Ferguson and Hockenson) and just 2 healthy RBs. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 5: Brock You Like a Hurricane 33%, Gibb it to Me Baby 21%, Mr. Action Jackson 11%.
📈 TRENDING: Every other league is scrambling for Dohnte Meyers (WR, CIN). Ours has him sitting on waivers.
📈 Stock rising: 49er Faith-Fool has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
